title: Introduce Dependency Sheriff and Fastpath CI Lanes
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Added a new proactive dependency curation job (dep-sheriff) and a fastpath CI lane for sub-second lint/unit feedback. No runtime changes. Backwards-compatible CI additions.
description: Motivation: Developer feedback on large PRs is noisy and slow. Dependabot churn and transitive upgrades frequently cause surprise test failures that take on-call time to triage. This change introduces a two-part approach: (1) a 'Dependency Sheriff' job that proactively curates and triages incoming dependency update signals (dependabot PRs and automated bump PRs), applying an opinionated scoring policy and auto-filing curated follow-ups; (2) a 'fastpath' CI lane that provides low-latency lint + unit-test feedback for pushes and draft PRs while delegating expensive integration/e2e to a staged lane. The goal is faster developer iteration and fewer noisy regression escalations.
